title: REVOLUTION MEN'S LEAGUE | WEEK 8 RECAP
content: Week 8 was a statement-making stretch for the Revolution Men's League. Kevin Garrison went off for 40 points, Black blew the doors off with a monster second-half surge, Green survived a defensive slog against Pink, and Orange held serve in a game that swung possession by possession. Let's get into the action.

games.text: Green had to earn every bucket. Neither offense found much separation early, with Jibril Abdullahi doing the heavy lifting against a Pink defense keyed in on stopping penetration. Matt Riordan kept Pink within reach by attacking off the bounce, while Joe Luiz caught fire from beyond the arc. Meanwhile, Nick Lynn splashed a couple of triples to keep Green's offense afloat. Green edged ahead by the slimmest of margins at the break. Halftime: Green 36, Pink 35. The defensive tone carried right into the second half. Jeromy Anderson battled on the glass to keep Pink within striking distance, while Green leaned on Abdullahi's rebounding and playmaking and got timely buckets from Joe Sub to keep Pink at arm's length. Green's defense held just enough to close it out. Green won a low-scoring battle, 67-60.

performers.Pink: Joe Luiz — 20 pts, 5 REB; Matt Riordan — 17 pts, 7 REB, 3 AST; Jeromy Anderson — 7 pts, 13 REB, 1 AST
performers.Green: Jibril Abdullahi — 30 pts, 5 REB, 8 AST; Joe Sub — 15 pts, 4 REB, 3 AST; Nick Lynn — 12 pts, 7 REB

games.text: Kevin Garrison put Purple on his back. Garrison was nearly unstoppable, splashing threes and finishing at the rim to keep Purple in front almost single-handedly. Dylan Pratico and Brody Snow chipped in just enough to keep the offense balanced, and Purple carried a 39-36 edge into the break despite getting very little scoring outside of Garrison. Blue struggled to find any answers for him defensively. Halftime: Purple 39, Blue 36. Blue found its footing coming out of the break. Logan Letourneau and Drew Pelkey combined to carry Blue's offense, and Henry Cogswell provided a steady scoring punch to complement them. Dylan Mackie hit timely shots off the bench, and Blue's defense finally started making Garrison work for his looks. Blue outscored Purple 37-30 after the break to complete the comeback. Blue edged Purple, 73-69.

performers.Purple: Kevin Garrison — 40 pts, 3 REB, 2 AST; Dylan Pratico — 8 pts, 4 REB, 3 AST; Brody Snow — 8 pts, 6 REB, 1 AST
performers.Blue: Logan Letourneau — 19 pts, 5 REB, 1 AST; Drew Pelkey — 18 pts, 2 REB; Henry Cogswell — 14 pts, 7 REB

games.text: White hung tough for a half. Kyle Picard and Liam Walsh set the pace for Black inside, while Kaleb Swetty knocked down a few triples to keep the offense spread out. White answered behind Tyrone Conley's activity on the glass and Devin Bradford's outside shooting, and the two teams were separated by just a single point at the break. Halftime: Black 37, White 36. Black seized control immediately after halftime. Andy Sub caught fire from three, and Liam Walsh kept attacking to complete a double-double. Kyle Picard stayed aggressive from the outside, and Black's defense turned White over into transition buckets time and again. White got a strong second half from Kolby Bradford, but it wasn't nearly enough to slow Black's surge. Black outscored White 48-30 after the break to blow the game open. Black rolled, 85-66.

performers.Black: Andy Sub — 20 pts, 5 REB, 6 AST; Liam Walsh — 18 pts, 12 REB, 3 AST; Kyle Picard — 18 pts, 4 REB, 1 AST
performers.White: Tyrone Conley — 19 pts, 13 REB, 1 AST; Kolby Bradford — 12 pts, 3 REB, 5 AST; Devin Bradford — 11 pts, 10 REB, 1 AST

games.text: It took the length of the game for Orange to shake Gray. Matt Spear was Gray's engine early, scoring inside and on the glass, while Tommy Brockmyre added efficient buckets of his own. Orange leaned on Stefan Radan's all-around game and James Hare's shooting to answer, and Orange took a narrow 40-38 edge into the break. Halftime: Orange 40, Gray 38. Gray wasn't ready to pack it in. Spear kept attacking, and Brockmyre kept knocking down shots, pushing Gray right back into it. Orange countered with Josh Carter getting downhill and Stefan Radan controlling the glass and setting up teammates, while Kenny Black chipped in whenever Gray made a push. The two sides traded baskets down the stretch before Orange found enough separation late. Orange held on, 79-75.

performers.Gray: Matt Spear — 30 pts, 11 REB, 2 AST; Tommy Brockmyre — 20 pts, 2 REB, 1 AST; John Helsel — 11 pts, 4 REB
performers.Orange: Stefan Radan — 24 pts, 13 REB, 7 AST; Josh Carter — 21 pts, 7 REB, 4 AST; James Hare — 18 pts, 2 REB, 1 AST
